referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory refers to the entire transport life cycle. Airport infrastructure expenditures and environmental interventions are accounted for using the yearly transport performance at Zurich airport (478'800 tkm/a). Aircraft manufacturing is allocated based on the total life span of an aircraft (25'000 LTO), the average distance of a flight (7850km) and its average freight load (11.5t/unit); UUID: da0f6e45-5252-31db-b88a-b5ee05d69eef
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset describes the operation of aircrafts including taxying, take-off and landing covering fuel consumption and operation emissions. Aircraft manufacture and maintenance, airport construction, operation and dismantling are inputs to this dataset
referenceFunction.name: Transport, aircraft, freight, long-haul, Infrastruktur

technology.text: Aircraft operation modelled based on passenger aircrafts operated by Lufthansa Group in 2019. The emission profiles distinguish between LTO and cruise.

timePeriod.text: Start date refers to emission factor data. End date refers to year of reporting fuel consumption and transport activities

representativeness.samplingProcedure: fuel consumption is based on corporate data, emission profiles are based on FOEN statistics
